conviction_note: The quarter is effectively pre-guided (FY26 adj. EBITDA 'toward the lower end' of $380-410m less $282m year-to-date implies Q4 ~ $98m, and management said Q4 would be 'more of the same' as Q3's $99m), so the reaction turns on the first FY27 guide and on whether Q4 free cash flow of $58-78m arrives to hold the $90-110m FCF guide; counterparty volume (P&G baby/fem/family care volume +2.3%, KMB volume +2% for Jul-Sep) and easing resin lean mildly positive while a disputed and probably too-high revenue consensus and Europe weakness lean negative, so p_up 53 on an abs move of 8.5% (guide-initiation print on a $450m equity stub under ~$1.6bn net debt); impact_sum +1.5 vs scaled +0.51, the gap being many small same-sign proxies that individually carry little.

findings.finding: The Q4 FY26 EBITDA is effectively pre-announced: 'toward the lower end' of $380-410m minus $282m year-to-date ($93m Q1, $90m Q2, $99m Q3) implies ~$98m, management said Q4 demand would be 'more of the same' as Q3, but a ~$2m Europe pass-through lag carries into Q4 and 'toward' leaves room under $380m.

findings.finding: Holding the FY26 FCF guide of $90-110m requires Q4 FCF of $58-78m (YTD $32m) and Q4 operating cash flow of $74-94m against a FY CFO guide of $150-170m with capex cut to ~$60m; last year's Q4 delivered record CFO of $96m.

findings.independence: FY25 Q4 record CFO $96m (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/36218659/magnera-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-results); capex trimmed to $60m and 'nothing deferred' (https://www.earningswhispers.com/transcript/MAGN/Q32026).
